summary: The first-degree murder charge in 4FA-26-00112CR was dismissed on Friday, Oct. 9 on a finding that the defendant was found incompetent, and the case was closed; no press release and no news report has been published on it. A grand jury returned on Thursday in a fourth Fairbanks case, 4FA-26-01916CR, which this report had not previously carried; the correction to Thursday's figure of three is below. A man arrested at Tok was charged on Friday with second-degree sexual assault and second-degree assault, both Class B felonies, and a man arrested at Venetie was charged with second-degree sexual abuse of a minor. Nine criminal cases were filed in the Fairbanks area on Friday, four of them carrying no charge at all. Two Fairbanks defendants failed to appear on Friday and warrants were ordered. Troopers recorded a death investigation at Clear with no manner of death stated. Five open Fairbanks cases were added to the open-case list below after being found by name search; they were open throughout and were not previously listed here. The weekly court filing counts below are the court report's own counts for its own window, Oct. 3 to Oct. 9; eight case numbers the court opened on Oct. 8 resolve in the court's public database and appear nowhere in that report for a second consecutive week. The U.S. Attorney's press index for the District of Alaska could not be reached this morning and nothing is reported from it.

entries.title: First-degree murder charge dismissed after defendant found incompetent; Fairbanks case closed
body: The first-degree murder charge against Brian Jeffery Davenport was dismissed on Friday, Oct. 9, and the case was closed. The court file records the entry as a charge dismissed on a finding that the defendant was found incompetent.

The file carried one count of murder in the first degree, intent to cause death, under AS 11.41.100(a)(1)(A), an unclassified felony. The count was offence-dated Jan. 20, 2026 at Fairbanks and was flagged as domestic violence related. The indicted-charge field carried a stage date of Jan. 29, 2026.

A dismissal of criminal charges was filed on Thursday, Oct. 8, and the case was reassigned to a different judge the same day. The case status now reads Closed and no event remains on the file. No disposition code is recorded against the count.

The court file states no finding about the alleged conduct. A person against whom charges are dismissed stands charged with nothing. No press release and no news report has been published on the dismissal or the closure.

entries.title: Grand jury returns in a fourth Fairbanks case, on two felony vehicle and driving counts
body: A docket entry dated Thursday, Oct. 8 in 4FA-26-01916CR records a grand jury return. The case had not previously been reported here.

Elijay John Sam is charged with vehicle theft in the first degree under AS 11.46.360(a)(1), a Class C felony; failure to stop at the direction of an officer, reckless driving, under AS 28.35.182(a)(1), a Class C felony; and improper use of registration, title or plates under AS 28.10.481, an unclassified misdemeanour. All three counts are offence-dated Aug. 19, 2026 at Fairbanks. None is flagged as domestic violence related.
The indicted-charge and amended-charge fields are empty on all three counts, so the court file does not state which count or counts the grand jury returned on.

An arraignment held on Friday, Oct. 9 was followed by a felony pre-trial order effective Oct. 14. A Superior Court arraignment is set for Oct. 14, an omnibus hearing for Dec. 3 and a trial week for Dec. 21. He is charged, not convicted.

A Fairbanks police record of a booking at the 100 block of Lacey Street at noon on Oct. 9 corresponds to this case. That block is the Rabinowitz Courthouse, and the entry reflects a booking taken at a court hearing rather than an arrest made in the street.

entries.title: Man charged at Tok with second-degree sexual assault and second-degree assault
body: Thomias Nazhone Smith was charged on Friday, Oct. 9 at the Tok court with four counts arising from Oct. 8 at Tok.

The counts as filed are sexual assault in the second degree, sexual penetration without consent, under AS 11.41.420(a)(5), a Class B felony; assault in the second degree, injury with a weapon with intent, under AS 11.41.210(a)(1), a Class B felony; assault in the third degree, cause fear of injury with a weapon, under AS 11.41.220(a)(1)(A), a Class C felony; and criminal mischief in the fifth degree, damage under $250, a Class B misdemeanour. All four counts are flagged as domestic violence related.

An information amending the second count was filed the same day. An arraignment was held on Oct. 9 in Courtroom 102 at Fairbanks, and preliminary hearings are set for Oct. 15 and Oct. 29 at Fairbanks.

Troopers had recorded the arrest on Oct. 8 and named the same four offences. He is charged, not convicted. Tok is outside the Fairbanks area; the case is reported here because the defendant was remanded to the Fairbanks jail and is on the Fairbanks court calendar. The court record names no person recorded as a victim and no detail of the allegation is reproduced.

entries.title: Man charged with second-degree sexual abuse of a minor; offence recorded at Venetie
body: Benjamin Noah John Peter was charged on Thursday, Oct. 8 at the Fort Yukon court with one count of sexual abuse of a minor in the second degree, sexual penetration, victim aged 13 to 15, under AS 11.41.436(a)(1)(A)(i), a Class B felony.
The count is offence-dated Sep. 17, 2026 and the offence location is recorded as Venetie. The count is not flagged as domestic violence related.
An arraignment was held on Friday, Oct. 9 in Courtroom 102 at Fairbanks. Preliminary hearings are set for Oct. 15 and Oct. 29 at Fairbanks.

A trooper report of the arrest recorded one count of sexual abuse of a minor in the first degree; the court file carries the second degree, and the court file is the charge of record. A second trooper entry records an arrest at Venetie on a $150,000 warrant for sexual abuse of a minor in the second degree.

He is charged, not convicted. Venetie and Fort Yukon are outside the Fairbanks area; the case is reported here because the defendant is on the Fairbanks court calendar. No person recorded as a victim is identified in the court record and no detail of the allegation is reproduced.

entries.title: Four charges filed at Delta Junction, and a warrant served in a related felony case
body: Pavel Ivanovich Budnik was charged on Friday, Oct. 9 with four counts arising from Oct. 8 at Delta Junction: assault in the fourth degree, recklessly injure, under AS 11.41.230(a)(1), a Class A misdemeanour flagged as domestic violence related; violating a condition of release for a felony under AS 11.56.757(a)(misdA), a Class A misdemeanour; violating conditions of release for a misdemeanour, a Class B misdemeanour; and harassment in the first degree, offensive contact with fluids, under AS 11.61.118(a)(1), a Class A misdemeanour.
An arraignment was held on Oct. 9 at the Fairbanks courthouse and a rural calendar call is set for Oct. 20 at Delta Junction.

On the same day, a return of service was docketed in an earlier Delta Junction case filed against the same name, 4DJ-26-00056CR, on a warrant issued Oct. 6. That case carries two indicted Class C felony counts. An arraignment in it was held Oct. 9, a Superior Court arraignment is set for Oct. 14, an omnibus hearing for Nov. 5 and a trial week for Nov. 23.
He is charged, not convicted, in both cases. The court record names no person recorded as a victim.

entries.title: Fairbanks woman charged with fourth-degree assault after a Kellum Street arrest
body: Josephine Alice Marie Phillips was charged on Friday, Oct. 9 with one count of assault in the fourth degree, recklessly injure, under AS 11.41.230(a)(1), a Class A misdemeanour flagged as domestic violence related. The count is offence-dated Oct. 8 at Fairbanks.
Fairbanks police recorded the arrest at the 300 block of Kellum Street at 21:10 on Oct. 8. The charge police recorded and the count the court filed agree.
An arraignment was held Oct. 9. A pre-trial conference is set for Nov. 24 and a trial week for Dec. 7. She is charged, not convicted. The court record names no person recorded as a victim.

entries.title: Fairbanks man charged with fourth-degree assault after a Twelfth Avenue arrest
body: Samuel Joseph Cobbs was charged on Friday, Oct. 9 with assault in the fourth degree, recklessly injure, under AS 11.41.230(a)(1), a Class A misdemeanour, and with violating conditions of release for a misdemeanour, a Class B misdemeanour. Both counts are offence-dated Oct. 9 at Fairbanks. The assault count is recorded as not domestic violence related.

Fairbanks police recorded the arrest at the 500 block of Twelfth Avenue at 05:56 on Oct. 9, with a companion simple-assault incident recorded at the 400 block of Twelfth Avenue and Lacey Street at 05:37 under the same case number. The court file carries a violating-conditions count that the police record does not.
An arraignment was held Oct. 9 and a pre-trial conference is set for Nov. 24. He is charged, not convicted.

entries.title: Criminal mischief charge filed after a Doyon Place arrest
body: Dateen Duane Arkell was charged on Friday, Oct. 9 with criminal mischief in the fifth degree, damage under $250, under AS 11.46.486(a)(2), a Class B misdemeanour, and with violating conditions of release for a misdemeanour, a Class B misdemeanour. Both counts are offence-dated Oct. 8 at Fairbanks.

Fairbanks police recorded the arrest at the 100 block of Doyon Place at 17:05 on Oct. 8, with a companion criminal mischief incident at 17:52 under the same case number. The charges police recorded and the counts the court filed agree.

A pre-trial conference is set for Nov. 24. This is the third open case filed under the same name in the Fairbanks court this autumn; the records do not connect them beyond the name. He is charged, not convicted.

entries.title: Disorderly conduct charge filed after a College Road arrest
body: Justin Ray Tonelli was charged on Friday, Oct. 9 with disorderly conduct, create a hazardous condition, under AS 11.61.110(a)(6), a Class B misdemeanour, offence-dated Oct. 8 at Fairbanks.
Fairbanks police recorded the arrest at the 200 block of College Road at 19:12 on Oct. 8, with a companion incident at 18:09. The charge police recorded and the count the court filed agree.
An arraignment is set for Oct. 16. He is charged, not convicted.

entries.title: Two arrested after a rollover off the Steese Highway; neither court file carries the charges reported
body: Troopers recorded a single-vehicle rollover off the Steese Highway at about 01:20 on Friday, Oct. 9, with two occupants.

The trooper report records that Garet Jones, 23, was arrested on charges of driving under the influence and refusal to submit to a chemical test, and that a passenger, Gabriel Waxman, 23, was arrested on a charge of disorderly conduct. Both were taken to the Fairbanks Correctional Center.

Two Fairbanks court files were opened on Oct. 9 under those names, 4FA-26-02053CR and 4FA-26-02052CR. Each records one count as a charging document pending or not filed, with no degree of offence. Neither file carries any of the three charges the trooper report names, and one of the two carries no docket entry at all.
Arraignment dates of Oct. 16 are carried on both files. Both men are arrested and, as the court files stand, charged with nothing. Ages are as the trooper report states them.

entries.title: Troopers record a death investigation at Clear
body: Troopers recorded a death investigation at Clear on Wednesday, Oct. 8 at 07:54. The entry was posted on Oct. 9.

The report states that Sheri Brown, 55, of Clear, was found deceased at her residence, that no foul play is suspected, that the State Medical Examiner was notified and that her remains were released to the family. Next of kin were present.
No manner of death is stated in the report and none has been announced. No court record returns under the name.

entries.title: Two Fairbanks defendants failed to appear on Friday and warrants were ordered
body: Two cases on the Friday, Oct. 9 calendar record a failure to appear and a warrant to issue.

In 4FA-26-02011CR, a bail hearing set for 09:30 on Oct. 9 records that the defendant failed to appear and that a warrant is to issue. The file carries one count of felony driving under the influence with two or more prior convictions, a Class C felony. Two preliminary hearings previously set for Oct. 13 and Oct. 22 are now vacated and no event stands on the file.

In 4FA-26-02009CR, an entry for an 08:30 hearing on Oct. 9 records a failure to appear and a warrant to issue. The file carries one count of criminal trespass in the second degree, a Class B misdemeanour, offence-dated Oct. 3. Counsel was appointed from the bench the same day. A pre-trial conference set for Dec. 3 and a trial week set for Dec. 14 are now vacated.
Both defendants are charged, not convicted.

entries.title: Judge changed in the North Pole kidnapping case; hearings reset
body: The judge assigned to 4FA-26-01890CR changed on Friday, Oct. 9 following a peremptory disqualification filed by the defence. It is the second change of judge on the file since Sep. 22.
The three counts are unchanged and include an indicted count of kidnapping under AS 11.41.300(a)(1)(C), an unclassified felony, offence-dated Sep. 22 at North Pole.

A preliminary hearing set for Oct. 12, an omnibus hearing set for Nov. 5 and a trial week set for Nov. 23 are all vacated. A calendar call now stands for Nov. 17 and a trial week for Nov. 30. Bail is recorded at $2,500 as of Oct. 8. He is charged, not convicted.

entries.title: Fairbanks arrest recorded on South University Avenue with no court file
body: Fairbanks police recorded an arrest at the 1700 block of South University Avenue at 18:33 on Friday, Oct. 9, on charges recorded by police as criminal trespass in the second degree and violating conditions of release.
No court file carrying those charges returns under the name on a dated name search. Two earlier Fairbanks cases under the same name remain open, one of them with no docket entry since Sep. 16.
The person is arrested, not convicted, and no charge class is stated because no court file has been identified.

entries.title: Two non-criminal traffic citations filed at North Pole
body: Two Minor Offense files were opened on Thursday, Oct. 8 in the Fairbanks court on citations written at North Pole on Oct. 7, both brought by the City of North Pole.

4FA-26-05259MO records driving with a licence cancelled, suspended or revoked under AS 28.15.291(a)(2) as an infraction, non-criminal, with an arraignment set for Nov. 12. 4FA-26-05260MO records failure to provide proof of insurance under AS 28.22.019 as a minor offence under the bail and fine schedule, non-criminal, with a fine due and no hearing set.
Both are non-criminal matters. North Pole publishes no public incident feed, and the court files are the only public record of the stop.

entries.title: Forty-seven criminal cases filed in the Fairbanks area in the week to Oct. 9
body: The Alaska Court System's weekly criminal charges report, run at 9:01 p.m. on Oct. 9 for the window Oct. 3 to Oct. 9, lists 41 cases filed at Fairbanks, four at Nenana, two at Delta Junction and none at Healy. It is the fifteenth consecutive week with no case filed at the Healy court.
Eight of the Fairbanks cases were filed on Friday, Oct. 9, numbered 4FA-26-02050CR to 02057CR. Three of the eight carry no charge at all, recorded as a charging document pending or not filed.

Eight further case numbers that the court opened on Oct. 8, 4FA-26-02042CR to 02049CR, resolve in the court's own public database but appear nowhere in the weekly report for a second consecutive run. Each is filed against a party recorded as Grand Jury, with one count recorded as a charging document pending and no docket.
Counts in this report are the report's own counts for its own window and are a floor rather than a total.
